ModMetaData.name: Starjack - Astrogene Whitelist
ModMetaData.author: DanZinagri
ModMetaData.description:
Choose which genes Vanilla Races Expanded - Starjack turns into astrogenes.
Starjack makes a free astrogene copy of every loaded gene that fits its criteria, which with a lot of gene mods means hundreds of them. With this mod only a curated default list is created. Everything else Starjack could build is listed in the mod settings, switched off, with a search box and a tick box per gene, so you can turn on exactly the ones you want (or turn off defaults you do not).
Changes apply after a restart, because astrogenes are created while the game loads. Pawns in an existing save lose any astrogene you switch off.
The default list is an XML def (StarjackAstrogeneWhitelist.AstrogeneWhitelistDef), so other mods can add their own list or patch this one.
Originally part of Too Many Mods - Compats and Rebalances by Warachia.
